definitions.explanation: A homogeneous liquid mixture in which one substance (the solute) is dissolved in another (the solvent). A standard chemistry and science term. Composed of 溶 (dissolve) + 液 (liquid).

examples.japanese: {食塩|しょくえん}{水|すい}は{溶液|ようえき}の{一種|いっしゅ}だ。
examples.english: Saltwater is a type of solution.

examples.japanese: この{溶液|ようえき}を{十分|じゅうぶん}にかき{混|ま}ぜてください。
{実験|じっけん}では{濃度|のうど}の{異|こと}なる{溶液|ようえき}を{三|みっ}つ{用意|ようい}した。
examples.english: For the experiment, we prepared three solutions of different concentrations.

notes:
USAGE:
{溶液|ようえき} is used in science classes, laboratories, and technical writing. It is the standard term for a chemical solution, distinct from {液体|えきたい} (liquid in general).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水溶液|すいようえき} (aqueous solution)
- {溶液|ようえき}の{濃度|のうど} (concentration of a solution)
- {溶液|ようえき}を{混|ま}ぜる (to mix a solution)
- アルカリ{溶液|ようえき} (alkaline solution)
- {酸性|さんせい}{溶液|ようえき} (acidic solution)
